build.test_scope: Memory-backed controller tests and stop-gateway tests; no robot hardware nodes launched.

verification.local_regression: 351 passed plus 48 subtests: behaviors, FC and runtime identity. Existing Starlette warning only.
verification.real_ros_fake_robot: Walk and explicit sprint pulses, wrong-stock refusal without commands, lost observation abort at 0.251 s; synthetic 20x48 feedback. Launcher description-only verified seven nodes and seven exit handlers, zero actions executed.
verification.pretransfer_abi_screen: 14 tests passed with no skips, including 8 real saved ELF checks: incompatible v1 controller/gateway/mux rejected; Pi-native v2 accepted; same R5 driver accepted in both. See build audit. Independent review found and corrected a sectionless-ELF false pass; the patched real-v1 regression now refuses before inspection.

release_archive.limitation: One non-runtime generated Python bytecache changed during staging imports after inventory. Selected source/binaries/manifests match. Archive is retained exactly; per-member archive index is authoritative for this saved archive. Set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for receipt imports; exclude caches from future packages.

changes: Native velocity command expires 250 ms after last receipt; generation prevents old activation callbacks replaying. Existing unsupported target/trick semantics unchanged.
Preflight requires exact manifest/config/policy and Pi dependencies; launch verifies selected package resolution; each trial verifies actual driver/controller mappings and current manager.

Short axis pulse tool records requested/policy-input/zero timing and refuses competing publishers; same homed session supports multiple trials. No motion/gain/current/joint-limit changes from the trial tool.
Separate walk and sprint-candidate profiles select initialized velocity caps. Sprint candidate remains physically unaccepted; initial pulses stay low.

held.v1: Ubuntu24.04 binary requires GLIBC2.38/GLIBCXX3.4.32; Pi Debian12 provides GLIBC2.36/GLIBCXX3.4.30. Preserved, never activated.
held.prior_run: Old installed driver lacked known shutdown/IMU fixes and aborted shutdown. It is not selected for v2; not a proven explanation for all observed gait instability.
held.detector: Temporary multicolor ball candidate failed held-out alignment/distractor checks; not used as reliable shot input.

unchanged: Global Pi native installation and teammate /home/pi/kick preserved; no source pull/rebuild into a running teammate session.
limits: v2 still needs watched startup, command delivery, stopping and full driver shutdown acceptance.
Runtime maps bind driver/controller; gateway/mux executable resolution checked before launch but process mappings not yet pinned. Underlay dependency closure is not frozen.
Source/config identities do not prove actual policy tracking, ball contact or braking distance. No accepted stock shot, sprint or lateral sprint yet.
R5 repaired driver lacks the later queued IMU age guard; exact selected driver is recorded, not assumed latest source.
Archive retains one regenerated nonselected Python cache entry differing from its staging inventory; all selected roles match and a full archive-members index is preserved.
next: Physical work closed. After reboot and supervisor readiness: new v2 preflight; home once; low turn/forward/braking pulses and faster forward only if controlled; no shot adapter during pulses. Stock shots follow measured movement acceptance.

prepared_session.resume: After power cycle create a fresh preflight receipt for the unchanged v2 release. Old receipt is boot-bound and must not be reused.

source_after_freeze: Repository movement_trial.py introduction corrected after v2 freeze; executable logic unchanged. The selected copied v2 tool remains exactly pinned in its manifests.

future_perception_review.reproduced: Optical-frame ball accepted as body coordinates; ten-second-old wrong-frame goal restamped at receipt produced fresh 90-degree aim; zero-stamp goal accepted.
future_perception_review.next: Exact frame admission and original goal stamp validity/order; further goal/field time-coherent geometry needed before enabling live camera shots. No v2 runtime change.
